clips.title: The story
paras: Brambleblade Ravine is a rugged canyon cutting into the northeastern edge of Red Cloud Mesa. It serves as a fortified den for the Bristleback quilboar tribe, who persistently raid the nearby tauren settlement of Camp Narache. Young tauren braves are sent here to prove their strength and protect their homeland from these fierce interlopers.

Carved into the sun-scorched earth of Red Cloud Mesa, Brambleblade Ravine is choked with dense, thorny briars and quilboar encampments. The Bristleback tribe uses this natural fortress as a staging ground for raids against Camp Narache, threatening the safety of young tauren coming of age. Bristleback shamans and warriors, led by Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle, dwell deep within the ravine among trained battleboars. For the Shu'halo, striking into the heart of the canyon is a crucial rite of passage and a grim necessity to secure the plains.
